name: Gabbie Vasquez
bio:
Gabbie Vasquez is a highly skilled tattoo artist based in Glasgow, UK, known for her proficiency in neotraditional tattoo designs. Working from the prestigious Morteza Tattoo studio, her professional approach and dedication to her craft are reflected in the intricate, vibrant pieces of art she creates on skin. Gabbie ensures a clean, orderly environment, upholding the highest standards of hygiene, providing clients not only with remarkable tattoos but also with a comfortable and secure environment to receive them.
